description:
These red gutka tiles for living room walls are thin clay brick-face tiles in the classic red brick colour, used to build a feature wall with the look of exposed brick.

## How they look
Red gutka is the traditional Pakistani brick finish seen on house fronts and boundary walls, brought indoors. The natural clay colour gives a warm, earthy backdrop that works behind a TV unit, a sofa or bookshelves.

## Where they work
- **TV and sofa feature walls** in lounges and drawing rooms.
- **Dining room or stairwell accent walls**.
- **Café, restaurant and office interiors** that want a heritage brick look.

The same tile also suits many exterior uses; see [gutka tiles in Lahore](/blog/gutka-tiles-in-lahore-sizes-uses-and-how-to-choose) for sizes and outdoor advice.

## Good to know
Indoors, gutka is usually fixed with tile adhesive or mortar and pointed with a cement or grey joint. Clay can show white salt marks (efflorescence) when moisture moves through the wall, so let the wall dry fully before fixing and consider a breathable sealer afterwards.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and compare it with the [yellow gutka option](/products/handmade-natural-yellow-gutka-brick-kitchen-wall-tiles), then get a dated quote for your wall area.

faqs.q: What is the price of red gutka tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Why do white marks appear on gutka walls?
faqs.a: White marks are usually efflorescence, salts carried out of the wall by moisture. Letting the wall dry fully before fixing and using a breathable sealer afterwards tends to reduce them.

faqs.q: Gutka tiles or real brick for a feature wall?
faqs.a: Gutka tiles give the same brick face but are much thinner, so they add little thickness and weight to an existing wall. A real brick wall is a construction job and takes more space.

faqs.q: How can I see the colour first?
faqs.a: Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) or visit the Lahore or Islamabad showroom.
